title: 科技八巨头：估值跌至历史低位，一个催化剂就能引爆？
speaker: Marvin Chen

segments.en: On the AI theme rotation, we're seeing some signs of rotation away from the build-at-all costs to more of a monetization focus.
segments.zh: AI主题轮动方面，我们看到从不计成本投入转向聚焦变现的迹象。

segments.en: And companies such as Tencent, Alibaba, can see some sentiment recovery with somewhat lower competitive AI spending.
segments.zh: 腾讯、阿里巴巴等公司因AI竞争性支出降低，情绪有所修复。

segments.en: And lastly, as a value rotation, right, the tech-8 are trading at historical valuations.
segments.zh: 最后，作为价值轮动，科技八巨头正以历史估值交易。

segments.en: So any kind of catalyst can really drive re-rating for these group of stocks.
segments.zh: 因此，任何催化剂都可能推动这些股票的重估。

segments.en: Then how do we need to look at right now, Korea and Taiwan, and how much further of this leveraging is going to happen?
segments.zh: 那么如何看待韩国和台湾？杠杆化还会持续多久？

segments.en: Yeah, so I mean, the leveraging has been occurring in Korea and Taiwan, but really in Korea, it's the leverage has been driving volatility, historical highs.
segments.zh: 是的，韩国和台湾的杠杆化一直在进行，但在韩国，杠杆正推动波动率升至历史高位。
